initial.prompt: Use case ui-mockup. Create a crisp high-fidelity desktop productivity app design board for a fully custom HTML/CSS/JavaScript Tasks sidebar docked inside Obsidian next to its existing Day Planner calendar. Evolve the approved dark charcoal mockups toward Morgen-inspired restraint. Flat #191b20 and #22252b surfaces, subtle #30343c hairlines, off-white text, muted blue accent, tiny readable outline icons, Inter typography, clean spacing, 8px corners, lightweight borderless icon controls. The calendar has muted blue, green and plum category blocks. Use realistic short task names only, synthetic task data, no IDs, code, promotional copy, decorative badges, native raised Obsidian settings buttons or heavy form boxes. Main labels should be legible and concise. The panel content is completely custom designed. Produce ONE large app screenshot, landscape 1536x1024. Main composition a 360px Tasks sidebar left and a spacious day calendar right. Sidebar header Tasks, a small Todoist source button with red brand mark and chevron, quiet refresh and settings icons, prominent small blue plus icon for Add task. A compact search input below. Flat segmented control Date / Project with Date selected. A small filter action for All projects. One compact collapsed amber sync row '2 need review' below toolbar. Task list Overdue collapsed count 2, Today expanded count 4, Tomorrow collapsed count 3. Today rows Review build with small Work chip and schedule chip 10:00–10:45, Shopping with Karma chip and nested Buy fruit and Buy rice, Read chapter with Apara chip, Sit with Yukti chip. Circle completion controls, title first, tiny muted tags below, row actions visible on selected/hover state only. Selected Shopping row has a restrained blue wash and one ellipsis action. Shopping is a single parent row with two child rows and its 11:00–11:30 schedule chip. One unobtrusive footer connection status 'Synced' and account label. Calendar heading Wednesday, 11 November, Today and day/week controls. Correctly aligned calendar blocks Planning 09:00–09:30, Review build 10:00–10:45, Shopping 11:00–11:30, Sit 12:00–12:30. Thin readable times, no duplicate task blocks. Show the whole usable app content with no operating system frame.
